notes.title: Dive into Power Sink on May 22
notes.content:
Western Australia-based indie studio Winterwire Games is thrilled to announce the upcoming release of their debut title, Power Sink, a circuit-solving puzzle platformer set beneath the sea. Power is failing, and it’s up to you to bring the lights back on when Power Sink dives onto Steam and Nintendo Switch on May 22nd for $14.99 USD / $22.95 AUD / £12.79 / €14,79!

See the logic-driven puzzles and classic platforming in action—watch the new trailer:
[previewyoutube=lhUpXxP4xd4;full][/previewyoutube]
Set in the ruins of a submerged power station, Power Sink blends classic platforming with clever logic-based puzzles as players take on the role of a Diver sent to restore power to a fading underwater colony. As you descend deeper through six beautifully crafted biomes, the puzzles grow more complex, and the mystery of what caused the station’s collapse begins to surface.

Armed with only your problem-solving skills and control over the station’s circuits, you'll reroute power through decaying systems, jump across collapsing platforms, and uncover the secrets hidden in the deep. Guided by voice comms from fellow Tidekeepers, players will piece together the station’s purpose—and their own.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548314/6a5ff0c72295617517250e016329086fb8be8538.jpg

Key Features:

 Logic-Based Circuitry Puzzles - Every puzzle is a circuit waiting to be solved. Switch connections, complete pathways, and restore power by interacting with different components in clever ways. The deeper you go, the trickier the puzzles become.
 Classic Platforming - Run, jump, and navigate the submerged ruins with fluid, satisfying movement, balancing precision platforming with puzzle-solving.
 Six Diverse Underwater Biomes - From faded steel corridors to glowing depths alive with energy, various biomes guide your descent. The station’s architecture grows more intricate, its colors more vibrant, and the surrounding marine life more varied as you restore power and uncover its secrets.
 A Descent into Mystery - Your mission begins where the power failed. Fellow Tidekeepers instruct and guide you, their voices familiar in the depths. The station’s story begins with a blackout and ends with a choice only you can make.
 Atmospheric Soundtrack - The station comes alive with creaks, groans, and echoes of the deep, accompanied by an atmospheric, handcrafted soundtrack designed to pull you further into the abyss.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548314/2f0c39065447912f73a1475bceab40c799ad76b3.jpg

Power Sink will be available on Steam and Nintendo eShop on May 22nd for $14.99 USD / $22.95 AUD / £12.79 / €14,79. Join our Discord and follow on Facebook, Bluesky, and Twitter/X, and TikTok to stay up-to-date.

notes.title: Power Sink Demo Update
notes.content:
In celebration of Pixel Expo: Act III, and the brand new demo we created for it, we've extended the ability to try out this demo to all of those who missed out or simply couldn't attend!

The new Power Sink Demo features:


 5 prologue levels
 Brand new puzzle mechanics
 3 completely unique underwater biomes to explore
 10+ new kinds of fish & flora
 The Diver's family, The Tidekeepers!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548314/80bbf248dcf7a69c09d9ab6b47762f5a5cd1d64f.png

All of that and more is waiting for you in this latest early-access peak at Power Sink, so get to playing and let us know what you thought on our Discord server!

notes.title: Sunny Reef Demo Update
notes.content:
Power Sink has a new Demo Update!

To celebrate the production support being provided by Screenwest, we've decided to take the last 10 months worth of updates and work we've been putting into Power Sink since the Puzzle Fest last year and put together a brand new Demo experience.

Of course this demo is still an in-development sneak peek at the game, but to keep you all up to date and hopefully show you some of the exciting new updates we've been working, why not let people get their hands on it!

We'd love to hear your feedback so join us on our Discord server after giving the new Demo a go!!
Power Sink Discord Server

Check out the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=wtMIyUy98js;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your continue support and we can't wait to see what you all think!!
